 {#ca#} <ls>Uṇ. 4. 223</ls>]
_meanings:
(<ab>lit.</ab>) Not killed or destroyed or obstructed; <ab>Ved.</ab> without
 a rival, incomparable, unattainable, inaccessible; unobstructed, not liable
 to be hurt or injured; {#SaMBuvaM mantraM devA anehasam#} <ls>Rv. 1. 40. 6</ls>, <ls n="Rv. 1. 40.">4</ls>, <ls n="Rv.">6. 50. 3</ls>.

({#hA-hasO#} <ab>&c.</ab>) Time (not being liable to be
 destroyed). <ab>cf.</ab> {#tasmAdanehasaM kaMcitpratIkzasva mahABuja#} <ls>Śiva B. 9. 18</ls>
 also <ls n="Śiva B.">5. 11, 59</ls>. {#kusumabARasaKena suKAsitaM vipinamApi na mAnamanehasA#}
 <ls>Rām. Ch. 4. 11</ls>.
